scientific_integrity: Theorem proved for fixed nonzero Fourier frequency in the deterministic unit-torus hydrodynamic PDE with unit mass, critical Curie--Weiss coupling, and positive initial magnetization; the coefficient is generic outside an exact one-dimensional exceptional solution subspace. Symbolic algebra and finite-time integration are checks, not infinity proofs.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic as time tends to infinity after the hydrodynamic model has been specified; not a uniform microscopic-particle theorem.
Not uniform over all Fourier frequencies or torus lengths.
Uniqueness in all literature is not certified; general adiabatic spectral analysis can contain the result implicitly.
title: Critical alignment yields a sharp square-root enhancement of spatial relaxation
